# KM-161 — CI repair pass 2 (before acceptance)

**Lane:** platform · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-150 · **Serializes with:** none (it may touch any file; keep each fix minimal)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** none exclusive. The surface is whatever the failing CI steps on `main` point at, at pickup.

## Outcome

The `CI` workflow's `validate` job is green on a PR based on `main` after the build lane has integrated, meaning KM-150 has merged with the agent client, MCP server, hooks, agent-join routes and confirm page. Then KM-151 (local acceptance) and KM-152 (the production deploy) start from a green `main`. This ticket **waits for CI**: the worker watches the PR's CI run and iterates until it is green, without weakening any test.

## Context and evidence

- KTD11: CI is not a merge gate; a CI-fix pass runs every few merges. This is the second pass. It sits on the critical path before acceptance because KM-152 deploys an exact SHA, and that SHA should be green.
- New code since pass 1 (KM-160):
  - `packages/agent` (`@khala/agent`, KM-103, KM-110, KM-141 to KM-147);
  - `packages/contracts/src/m1/` (KM-104, KM-170, KM-171);
  - control `agent-join/` (KM-131 to KM-133);
  - web `features/agent-confirm/` (KM-134), attribution (KM-135) and cross-signing (KM-130);
  - possibly the design lane (KM-180 and later), which changes screenshots;
  - the events lane (KM-172 to KM-175).
- Likely failure classes:
  - live tests that ran without a stack;
  - lockfile drift (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) after several dependency edits;
  - terminology and boundary checks on new agent and web code (`scripts/check-terminology.mjs`, `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs`);
  - visual baselines after intended UI changes.

## Scope

Every failing step of the most recent completed `CI` run on `main` at pickup (record its run ID and head SHA), plus further failures in those steps surfaced by the fix PR's own CI.

## Non-goals

- Failures from merges after the pickup SHA: list them in the PR body for the Executor.
- Running or fixing the four-party acceptance: **KM-151**. Running or fixing production: **KM-152**.
- Live stack tests (`*.live.test.ts`, `tests/integration/human/*.spec.ts`): not CI gates.
- Feature changes to any lane's code beyond the minimal fix.

## Existing owner and reuse target (verified at `5db209cc`)

- Repo `aiur-team/khala`; workflow `ci.yml` (name `CI`), job `validate` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:22-69`, minus the steps KM-102 and KM-124 removed).
- Visual baseline command: `ci.yml:56-61`. The image tag must equal the `@playwright/test` version (`ci.yml:50-53`; `1.63.0` at `5db209cc`).
- Vitest includes `src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}` (`vitest.config.ts:11`), so `*.live.test.ts` runs by default unless the package excludes it.
- The `deletion-guard` required check fails on removed files until an admin approves the head SHA (`.github/workflows/deletion-guard.yml:34-54`).

## Contract and invariants

No contracts.md shape is produced or consumed. If a red test shows that code and a contract disagree (for example, a C2 status code or a C6 frame text), **do not change the contract and do not change the test to match the code**. Fix the code if the change is small and obviously contract-conformant; otherwise stop (see Risks).

**No test weakening.** None of the following is allowed:
- adding `.skip`, `.only`, `.todo`, `skipIf`, `--passWithNoTests` or `continue-on-error`;
- deleting or loosening an assertion, widening a matcher, or lowering a count;
- raising a timeout more than 2× without a measured reason;
- removing a CI step;
- deleting a test file. **Exception:** you may delete one only when every module it tests was deleted by a merged M1 ticket (cite it).
- updating screenshot baselines. **Exception:** you may update them only for a UI change intended by a merged ticket (cite the PR). Regenerate them in the pinned Playwright image with `--update-snapshots`, then run the two-pass check from `ci.yml:59-61`.
- Live tests are the one structural exception. Per contracts C1 (reconciliation A10), `*.live.test.ts` files are already excluded from each package's default `test` script and run only via `test:live` (KM-110 for `packages/agent`, KM-150 for its live tests). If one still runs in CI and fails only for lack of a stack, restore that exclusion and `test:live` in the package, following the same pattern, and name the ticket that dropped it.

## Implementation pointers (refreshable @ 5db209cc)

### Files

Determined at pickup. Typical surfaces: `packages/agent/package.json` scripts, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, adjacent tests of merged tickets, `apps/web/src/**/*-snapshots/`, `scripts/check-*.mjs` exceptions (only when a rule is wrong for new M1 code, never to hide a real violation).

### Worked example

```
$ gh run view 234567 --repo aiur-team/khala --log-failed | grep -m3 -E "FAIL|Error"
validate  pnpm test  FAIL packages/agent/src/matrix/session.live.test.ts > browser invites agent with history
validate  pnpm test  Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8443
```

Fix (structural exception above; this means KM-110's A10 exclusion is missing or was undone): in `packages/agent/package.json`, set `"test": "vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts --exclude '**/*.live.test.ts'"` and `"test:live": "vitest run --config ../../vitest.config.ts live.test"` (a filename filter). Confirm `--exclude` is accepted with `pnpm exec vitest --help`. Then `pnpm --filter @khala/agent test` passes and lists no live files. Commit `fix(ci): keep stack-only live tests out of the default agent test run (KM-110)`.

### Steps

1. Pickup:
   1. `git fetch origin && git switch -c fix/ci-pass-2 origin/main`.
   2. `gh run list --repo aiur-team/khala --workflow ci.yml --branch main --status completed --limit 1 --json databaseId,headSha,conclusion`. Record the result in the PR body.
   3. If it is green at `origin/main`, post that on the ticket and finish.
2. `gh run view <id> --repo aiur-team/khala --log-failed > /tmp/ci-fail.log`. List each failing step and its first error.
3. Reproduce locally in CI order: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:browser`, `pnpm build`. Use the visual baseline docker command when that step fails.
4. Fix each root cause minimally, one commit per cause, naming the step and the ticket that caused it.
5. Push. Open a PR titled `fix(ci): repair main before M1 acceptance (pass 2)`, with a failure → cause → fix table.
6. **Wait for CI:**
   1. `gh run list --repo aiur-team/khala --workflow ci.yml --branch fix/ci-pass-2 --limit 1 --json databaseId`.
   2. `gh run watch <id> --repo aiur-team/khala --exit-status`.
   3. Iterate on failures.

   Poll through `gh run` (REST) only. Never loop `gh pr view` or `gh pr checks` (GraphQL quota).
7. When it is green, comment on the ticket with the run URL. If any file was removed, flag `deletion-guard` (admin approval on the head SHA) in the PR body.

## Test scenarios

1. `validate` on the PR's final head: every step green.
2. Local `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build` green on the same head.
3. `git diff origin/main...HEAD | grep -nE '^\+.*(\.skip|\.only|skipIf|continue-on-error)|^-.*(expect\(|assert)'` has no unjustified hits.
4. If baselines changed: two consecutive `test:visual` runs in the pinned image pass, and `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src` is empty afterwards.

## Verification

```sh
gh run watch <pr-run-id> --repo aiur-team/khala --exit-status   # exit 0
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

Done when the PR's `validate` run is green and its URL is on the ticket, so the Executor can start KM-151 on a green SHA.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop and report** a contract mismatch or a real regression in agent-join, the agent client or delivery hooks. Name the merged ticket. These block AE6, so the Executor promotes a P0/P1 `discovered_from` ticket.
- **Stop** if green requires weakening a test, or requires changing a boundary or terminology rule to admit real violations.
- **Stop** if new root causes beyond the pickup scope exceed 3. Hand them back to the Executor.
- Never force-push `main`, never change workflow triggers or required checks, and never rerun a flaky step to green without a recorded cause.

## Complexity rationale

2: same shape as KM-160, with a larger and newer code surface. The fixes are still minimal and test-pinned, and waiting for CI adds wall time only.
